patch.value: GH-1655: SDK placeholder and type refusals name CLI flags, and parent: null is refused, so typed callers have no documented way to clear a field

Since GH-1614 (pm-gh1614) typed PmClient fields keep CLI sentinels literal. Typed SDK callers now get refusals written for the CLI: create/update parent 'none' says 'Use --unset parent', an empty parent says 'Use --parent none to unset', a self-parent says 'Use --unset parent', a missing strict parent says 'use --parent none', and parent/assignee null fail a string type check (invalid_argument_value) instead of meaning 'no value'. assignee 'none' now stores a person called none with no advisory. Reproduced on 2026.11.3 dist in a sandbox tracker.

Typed SDK create/update refusals for placeholder, empty and self parent name the SDK remedy (unset: ['parent'] or omit parent) and never a CLI flag, with a spec per refusal; A typed SDK null on a clearable scalar field (parent, assignee, and every field the unset list accepts) clears it exactly like unset: [field]; null on a field that cannot be cleared refuses naming the field, with specs; A typed SDK create/update whose clearable scalar equals a former clear sentinel (none, null, -) succeeds and returns a stable advisory warning naming the field and the unset form; CLI behaviour and wording are unchanged: --parent none still clears, and CLI refusals still name CLI flags, proven by the existing CLI specs; docs/SDK.md documents null-as-clear and the advisory, and the SDK surface snapshot records any type widening
A typed SDK caller that hits a parent refusal is told the SDK form, and null clears a clearable field
create({parent:'none'}) refuses naming --unset parent; create({parent:null}) refuses 'create parent must be a string.'; create({assignee:'none'}) stores the literal silently

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Implemented. (1) Caller vocabulary: core/item/literal-mutation-input.ts gains MutationInputAudience, mutationInputAudience (literal-marked typed SDK/MCP input is 'sdk', a CLI adapter's bag is 'cli'), mutationOptionLabel, sdkClearRemedy and emptyMutationOptionMessage. normalizeParentReferenceValue, validateMissingParentReference, assertParentReferenceIsNotSelf and validateSprintOrReleaseValue take an optional audience (default 'cli', so the public advanced exports keep their wording); create/update pass it, and update's empty assignee/closeReason refusals use it. SDK wording: parent must not be the placeholder "none". Pass unset: ["parent"] or null to clear it, or omit parent. (2) Null clears: foldNullClearsIntoUnset (sdk/lifecycle/shared-unset-fields.ts) rewrites a typed null on any option the command's unset list covers into its unset token, in both client dispatch (runtime-input normalizedActionOptions) and direct domain calls (prepareNativeMutationOptions). author is excluded (attribution, not a stored field) and keeps its by-name refusal, as do non-clearable fields like title. CREATE_/UPDATE_UNSET_FIELD_DEFINITIONS moved into shared-unset-fields.ts so the fold and both commands share one table (also frees update.ts headroom under the 3400 implementation-line cap). (3) Advisory: literalSentinelAdvisories emits literal_sentinel_stored:<field>:<value> when typed input stores none/null/- in a clearable string field; CLI input never gets it. Probe over 44 fields x 4 tokens (none, -, null, empty) on the rebuilt dist: every parent/sprint/release/assignee/closeReason refusal is SDK-worded; CLI wording verified unchanged in a sandbox (--parent '' / --assignee '' / --sprint '' / --close-reason '' / self parent / strict missing parent).

value.text: Codex review round 1, fixed: (P2) the public typed inputs did not admit the documented null clears, so client.create({ parent: null }) failed tsc. The unset tables in shared-unset-fields.ts are now 'as const satisfies', and PmCreateActionOptions/PmUpdateActionOptions make exactly the table's option keys (minus author) nullable; tests/types/typed-action-inputs.test-d.ts asserts null compiles for clearable fields and is a type error for title, author and create closeReason. (P2) update --status closed routed to close skipped the advisory; the routed-close result now adds literalSentinelAdvisories without repeating the pre-update's own.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Codex review round 2, fixed: (P2) the widened PmCreateActionOptions/PmUpdateActionOptions were no longer assignable to runCreate/runUpdate's CreateCommandOptions/UpdateCommandOptions, breaking wrappers like (o: PmCreateActionOptions) => runCreate(o, g). CreateOperationOptions/UpdateOperationOptions now carry the same nullable clearable fields (shared WithNullClears and Create/UpdateNullClearableOptionKey types in shared-unset-fields.ts), runCreate/runUpdate/runReopenUpdate/resolveUpdateTransportOptions take them and narrow after the fold; a type test compiles both wrappers. (P2) update-many's flat transport drops a null field silently (pre-existing), so PmUpdateManyActionOptions stays non-nullable and the runtime gap is filed as pm-w7clh6. (P2) MCP has no typed null, so the shared SDK/MCP remedy now names only unset: ["<field>"]; null stays documented in docs/SDK.md for typed SDK callers. (P3) literal_sentinel_stored is now emitted only when the resulting item still holds the sentinel (status canceled removes the assignee: no advisory), with specs.

value.author: harness:claude-code
value.text: Codex review round 3: fence, nullable types, MCP remedy and dependent recovery confirmed correct. One P3 fixed: a routed close (update --status closed) kept the pre-update's own literal_sentinel_stored warning although the close then removed the value; routed-close advisories now come only from the final closed item. Spec in literal-input.spec.ts (status closed + assignee none + force: warnings are exactly auto_routed_from_update_to_close); negative control: restoring the unfiltered pre-update warnings fails that spec.

patch.value: Verified on the rebuilt dist with a 44-option x 4-token PmClient probe: every scalar refusal is SDK-worded, null clears parent/assignee/sprint and the other unset-covered fields, the advisory appears only for stored sentinels, CLI wording is unchanged in a sandbox; specs in literal-input.spec.ts, literal-mutation-input.spec.ts, focus-command.spec.ts and the typed-action-inputs type test; 100% coverage

Caller vocabulary is derived from the literal-input provenance (mutationInputAudience): parent placeholder/empty/self/strict-missing and sprint, release, assignee and closeReason refusals name the option key and unset: ["<field>"] for typed SDK and MCP callers, while CLI wording is unchanged and the public validators default to it. foldNullClearsIntoUnset turns a typed null on any option the command's unset table covers into its unset token in client dispatch and in runCreate/runUpdate; author and non-clearable fields keep their by-name refusal. PmCreateActionOptions, PmUpdateActionOptions, CreateOperationOptions and UpdateOperationOptions type those fields as nullable, derived from the const unset tables; update-many stays on unset (pm-w7clh6 tracks its flat-transport null drop). literal_sentinel_stored:<field>:<value> is returned when typed input stores none/null/- and the resulting item still holds it, including routed closes. Remaining collection and dependency wording is pm-7lv8yx.
Fixed: typed SDK and MCP refusals name the SDK unset remedy instead of CLI flags, typed null clears every unset-covered create/update field, and literal sentinels stored from typed input are advised
